purpose.summary: This is a web-based CGI report program (PW02130R) that generates a 'Drop Size' report for a beverage/distribution company. It reads delivery route data (maps, orders, vehicles, drivers, helpers, customers, products, municipalities) from indexed files and produces analytical or synthetic reports showing delivery quantities in cases or hectoliters, weight, and drop-size metrics. The program supports multiple grouping options (by vehicle, driver, helper, sales manager, supervisor, salesperson, district, map, customer, municipality).

CGI/HTML form integration via external-form and 'identified by' clauses (Micro Focus web extension)
Multiple COPY statements for both SELECT (PCS*.CPY) and FD/WS (PCF*.CPY) sections
Three indexed work files (arqwor, arqwor2, arqwor3) with dynamic access and manual locking
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS blocks
Drop-size calculation logic with caixas (cases) and hectoliters volume modes
verdict.notes: The file uses Latin-1 encoding with Portuguese characters (e.g., 'Parâmetros', 'Veículos'). The $set sourceformat"free" directive means the code is free-format despite the mechanical indicator guessing 'fixed' (likely due to indentation style). The program is clearly a production CGI web report for a Brazilian beverage distribution system.
